verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents enterprise SSO for any SAML or OIDC IdP, manages organizations and their connections, and imports organizations with their enterprise SSO connections from Auth0. Together these indicate per-organization SSO connections, and community users praise the SAML setup wizard. Directory Sync (SCIM) covers provisioning, but that is a different mechanism from just-in-time provisioning at login. Missing for 10: any evidence of domain verification for organizations, explicit just-in-time user provisioning on first SSO login, and direct documentation that each organization is bound to its own SSO connection.
